plain: The astronomer J. Allen Hynek, Michels says, gave a computer to Paul Bennewitz, an Albuquerque man who believed he was picking up alien signals in the 1980s. Michels adds that Bennewitz was being fed false information as a psychological operation by an Air Force officer named Rick Doty. Michels tells this himself as something he had just learned, without naming a source, and it would tie a well-known scientist to a government deception campaign.
